summary.intent: Fix the repeatedly failing weekly Quality Sweeps CI (fuzz build target and mutation-testing timeouts), ship changes via Entire trails rather than hand-opened PRs, then fix the real bug the fuzzer subsequently found.
summary.outcome: Sweep fix merged as #548 on trail #411; verification run showed 9/10 jobs passing, with manifest_editor fuzz finding a panic in python.rs set_version. A fix with regression test and changeset was committed and pushed on a new branch, but PR/merge status was not yet confirmed.

repo: Weekly sweeps are in callisto-quality.yml; the mutants step is `cargo mutants ... || [ $? -eq 2 ]`, so only exit 2 (missed mutants) is tolerated and exit 3 (timeouts) fails the shard.

Shard 3 is the only mutants shard that hits registry.rs, and it failed the same way on Nov 1, Nov 8 and later due to 3 timeout mutants in mask_bearer and redact_url_userinfo (cursor moves backwards, so the find loop never terminates).

No mutants config existed; `.cargo/mutants.toml` with line-number-independent exclude_re now excludes the `+`->`-` mutants. `cargo mutants --list` showed 5 dropped, slightly broader than the 3 timeouts (registry.rs:142 and :242 also).
Fuzz jobs never started because the build defaulted to a musl target; it now targets x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.

PRs in orin-dx repos are created through Entire (`trail create`, change flow, `ci-pr`), which creates and merges them; the `gh` shim opens PRs as a PR bot and needs a Touch ID token mint, which fails in this session.
The worktree guard rejects compound git commands, so git operations must be run as separate commands.
Repo changes carry a changeset in `.changeset/*.md`; commits are signed; local checks include clippy, fmt, a comment check and actionlint.

code.finding: set_version falls through to `self.document["project"]["version"] = value(new_ver)`, which panics ('index not found') when `project` is missing or not a table; the fuzz crash input was `project = ""`. Fixed to return a manifest error.
mask_bearer (143, 150) and redact_url_userinfo (233) have `+` -> `-` mutants that cause infinite loops, so they time out rather than get caught by tests.

workflow: Check how a repo opens PRs (here Entire trails/changes) before falling back to gh; the user expected the Entire flow.
The user does not want background watchers or polling that spend tokens unless they ask; check run status on request only.
Don't claim work is pending when the user can see no PR; verify state (e.g. via origin/main) before asking the user to act manually.
A subagent's report is only evidence, not authority; its diagnosis was used but verified with `cargo mutants --list`.

friction: The first gh pr create attempt failed on the Touch ID PR-bot token mint, and the assistant wrongly asked the user to run it by hand even though Entire had already merged the PR.
The assistant didn't realize the user's intent to use Entire until the user said so.
`ci-pr` first reported no open changes although `trail show` listed one, needing a retry with explicit project and change id.
A compound git command was refused by the worktree guard and had to be rerun as separate commands.
A background watcher was started despite the user's preference for no token-spending polling, and was then stopped.
The assistant said it would start the fix but hadn't, prompting the user's 'I don't see any PRs open'.
open_items: Confirm the python.rs `project`-not-a-table fix branch is pushed, a PR is opened and merged through Entire under trail #411, and re-run the manifest_editor fuzz job.
